title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Promoting the "Three-in-One" Work for the Trial of Intellectual Property Civil, Administrative and Criminal Cases in Courts Nationwide
keywords_en: administrative litigation; intellectual property; administrative and criminal cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Promoting the "Three-in-One" Work for the Trial of Intellectual Property Civil, Administrative and Criminal Cases Across the National Courts

Fa Fa [2016] No. 17

To implement the judicial system reform tasks identified at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, as well as the specific requirements set forth in the "Outline of the National Intellectual Property Strategy", "Several Opinions on Deepening Institutional and Mechanism Reforms to Accelerate the Implementation of the Innovation-Driven Development Strategy", and the "Implementation Plan for Deepening the Reform of the Science and Technology System"; to unify the standards for the application of law, optimize the allocation of trial resources, improve the quality and efficiency of trials, give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, promote the reform of the intellectual property trial system and working mechanism, accelerate the implementation of the innovation-driven development strategy, and establish a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist intellectual property judicial system; and in accordance with the "Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China", the "Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China", and relevant laws and regulations, and in light of the actual circumstances of trial work, this opinion is formulated.

I. Unify Thinking and Deeply Understand the Great Significance of Promoting the "Three-in-One" Work for the Trial of Intellectual Property Civil, Administrative and Criminal Cases

1. "Three-in-One" for the trial of intellectual property civil, administrative and criminal cases means that the Intellectual Property Trial Division uniformly hears intellectual property civil, administrative and criminal cases.

Promoting the "Three-in-One" work is an important measure for the people's courts to implement the judicial system reform tasks identified at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and is an important step in implementing the National Intellectual Property Strategy and the Innovation-Driven Development Strategy. The purpose of promoting the "Three-in-One" work is to establish a working mechanism and trial system that conforms to the characteristics and rules of intellectual property justice, and to continuously improve the overall effectiveness of intellectual property judicial protection.

2. Promoting the "Three-in-One" work is conducive to enhancing the coordination of law enforcement between judicial organs and administrative organs, achieving all-round relief and judicial fairness for intellectual property; conducive to unifying judicial standards, improving trial quality, and perfecting the judicial protection system for intellectual property; conducive to reasonably allocating trial forces, optimizing the allocation of trial resources, and improving the efficiency and effectiveness of intellectual property judicial protection; and conducive to building a specialized intellectual property trial team and improving the quality of intellectual property trial personnel. People's courts at all levels must unify their thinking and actions with the spirit and deployment of the central authorities, and comprehensively promote the "Three-in-One" work with a spirit of responsibility.

II. Actively Implement and Vigorously Promote the "Three-in-One" Work for the Trial of Intellectual Property Civil, Administrative and Criminal Cases

3. The Supreme People's Court establishes a coordination group for promoting the "Three-in-One" work to uniformly coordinate and guide the "Three-in-One" work of courts nationwide. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall establish corresponding coordination bodies to organize and coordinate the "Three-in-One" work within their respective jurisdictions, and shall be specifically responsible for the jurisdictional layout, guidance, and supervision of intellectual property cases within their jurisdictions, for transmitting information upward and downward, for internal and external coordination, and for promptly resolving issues arising in the work.

4. People's courts at all levels shall handle the trial of intellectual property criminal cases properly in accordance with the opinions jointly issued by the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on relevant issues concerning the application of law in handling intellectual property criminal cases.

5. The intellectual property trial departments of people's courts at all levels shall no longer be called the Civil Trial Division No. X, and shall be renamed as the Intellectual Property Trial Division.

6. The Intellectual Property Trial Divisions of people's courts at all levels shall equip themselves with trial forces according to the needs of trial tasks, and, depending on the circumstances, may be staffed with judges specializing in administrative trials and criminal trials; alternatively, judges from the Administrative Trial Division or Criminal Trial Division may jointly form a collegial panel with judges from the Intellectual Property Trial Division to hear intellectual property administrative or criminal cases.

7. Intellectual property civil cases refer to civil dispute cases involving intellectual property rights such as copyright, trademark rights, patent rights, technology contracts, trade secrets, new plant varieties, and layout designs of integrated circuits, as well as unfair competition, monopoly, and franchise contract cases.

General intellectual property civil dispute cases refer to intellectual property civil dispute cases other than those involving patents, new plant varieties, layout designs of integrated circuits, technical secrets, computer software, recognition of well-known trademarks, and monopoly disputes.

Intellectual property administrative cases refer to administrative dispute cases where a party, dissatisfied with an administrative act taken by an administrative organ in respect of intellectual property rights such as copyright, trademark rights, or patent rights, as well as unfair competition, initiates an administrative lawsuit with a people's court.

Intellectual property criminal cases refer to criminal cases of infringement of intellectual property rights as stipulated in Section 7 of Chapter III of the Specific Provisions of the "Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China", "Crimes of Disrupting the Order of the Socialist Market Economy", among others.

For intellectual property criminal cases initiated by private prosecution, the people's courts may still exercise jurisdiction in accordance with the territorial jurisdiction principles established by the Criminal Procedure Law.

8. The acceptance of intellectual property civil cases shall continue to be conducted in accordance with the provisions and approvals of the people's courts concerning territorial jurisdiction, hierarchical jurisdiction, and designated jurisdiction. In addition:

If there is no basic people's court within the jurisdiction of an intermediate people's court that has jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil dispute cases, the intermediate people's court may, after reporting level by level, request the Supreme People's Court to designate a basic people's court for unified jurisdiction, or the intermediate people's court itself may exercise jurisdiction by elevation over intellectual property administrative and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

If there are multiple basic people's courts within the jurisdiction of an intermediate people's court that have jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil dispute cases, after reporting level by level and obtaining approval from the Supreme People's Court, the intermediate people's court may divide and adjust the jurisdictional scope of each basic people's court based on factors such as the number of cases within its jurisdiction and trial forces.

A basic people's court having jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil dispute cases shall hear first-instance intellectual property criminal and administrative cases within the area designated by the intermediate people's court. If a basic people's court without jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil dispute cases discovers that a case it is hearing is an intellectual property administrative or criminal case, it shall promptly transfer the case to the basic people's court designated by the intermediate people's court that has jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil dispute cases.

The Intellectual Property Trial Division of an intermediate people's court shall hear appeals against intellectual property administrative and criminal cases concluded by basic people's courts within its jurisdiction, as well as intellectual property criminal cases protested by the people's procuratorate at the same level.

The Intellectual Property Trial Division of a higher people's court shall hear appeals against intellectual property administrative and criminal cases concluded by intermediate people's courts within its jurisdiction, applications for retrial of intellectual property administrative and criminal cases, and intellectual property criminal cases protested by the people's procuratorate at the same level.

The Intellectual Property Trial Division of the Supreme People's Court shall hear appeals against intellectual property administrative and criminal cases concluded by higher people's courts, applications for retrial of intellectual property administrative and criminal cases, and intellectual property criminal cases protested by the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

9. The compilation, use, and management of case numbers for intellectual property cases shall be implemented in accordance with the Supreme People's Court's "Several Provisions on Case Numbers of People's Courts". The type code in the case number shall be Zhi Min / Zhi Xing / Zhi Xing (Intellectual Property Civil / Intellectual Property Administrative / Intellectual Property Criminal).

III. Increase Efforts to Ensure the Smooth Progress of the "Three-in-One" Work for the Trial of Intellectual Property Civil, Administrative and Criminal Cases

10. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall make overall plans for the "Three-in-One" work within their respective jurisdictions, and provide strong support in terms of staffing, funding guarantees, and material equipment. They shall establish communication and liaison mechanisms with public security organs, procuratorial organs, and administrative law enforcement agencies for intellectual property, and coordinate with public security organs and procuratorial organs to handle the investigation and transfer for prosecution of criminal cases properly.

11. Trial management shall be strengthened to ensure case quality. The intellectual property case guidance system shall be accelerated and continuously improved to ensure uniformity of adjudication standards. Connections at all stages of case handling shall be well managed. The quality of written judgments in intellectual property cases shall be vigorously improved. Classified statistics on intellectual property cases shall be conducted, and information technology shall be fully utilized to strengthen the analysis and research of relevant data. Higher-level courts shall promptly conduct investigations and research to strengthen guidance and supervision over courts carrying out the "Three-in-One" work.

IV. Strengthen Training and Accelerate the Building of a Composite and Specialized Intellectual Property Trial Team

12. People's courts at all levels shall adhere to a long-term perspective, aim to cultivate a specialized team of judges capable of adapting to the development trend of intellectual property trials, strictly select trial business backbones, and ensure that judges involved in intellectual property trials possess the corresponding trial business capabilities and experience.

13. The Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts shall, each year at appropriate times, organize specialized training specifically targeting the "Three-in-One" work for intellectual property trials, and at the same time, pay attention to expanding the coverage of training through online methods, continuously improving the overall quality of intellectual property judges.

V. Miscellaneous

14. Local people's courts at all levels shall promptly summarize and exchange the experiences gained in the "Three-in-One" work, identify existing problems, and promptly report problems of a common nature level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

15. Local people's courts at all levels shall, starting from actual conditions, from the perspective of facilitating litigation for parties and being conducive to intellectual property judicial protection, comprehensively consider factors such as the level of economic development, transportation convenience, and the number of various types of intellectual property cases within their respective jurisdictions, and actively yet prudently promote the "Three-in-One" work.

The Beijing Intellectual Property Court, the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court, and the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court shall temporarily not implement the "Three-in-One" work.

16. If any previous provisions are inconsistent with this opinion, this opinion shall prevail.

July 5, 2016
